name: DMD 5820
title: Documentary Film Production
description: Introduction to camera and sound recording for small-crew documentary filmmaking. Students learn interviewing, ethics in documentary, and basic story structure. Through analysis of short and feature length documentary films, as well as hands-on directing, filming, and editing, students will learn the art and technique of documentary filmmaking.
requirement_description: Open to Digital Media and Design M.A. and M.F.A. students; instructor consent required. Recommended preparation: DMD 5210 and 5810.
